data.subject: Local Ledger for Ategra
data.body:
Hi,

Ategra's most recent 13F, for the period ending June 30, 2026, shows positions in HWBK, PKBK, and FVCB.

On September 4, 2026, HWBK filed an 8-K Item 2.01 reporting that it completed an acquisition or disposition of assets (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/893847/000089384726000091/hwbk-20260903.htm).

I can send the free weekly issue and a four-week fund pilot. Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
